|errata_history=This is version PC-E1 of [[The Mandalorian]], a title change (The Mandalorian → Jango Fett); it is the current card. The images are the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image, which print it. The release-sheet slip prints •The Mandalorian; see [[The Mandalorian]].
* '''Original''' ([[The Mandalorian]]): titled “•The Mandalorian” (lore “Trade Federation.”) on the Virtual Block 5 release sheet, slip 11: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May ▼ Jet Pack on him for free; he moves using it for -1 Force. Permanent weapon is Dual Blasters (may lose 1 Force to target a Jedi; until end of turn, choose: target may not fire weapons OR target loses immunity to attrition).”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 7, 2009"), page 2, slip 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-11-Jango_Fett.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list still showed the card under this title from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013.<ref name="cl-1250_8-old">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive; the same in the VMasterType list): “The Mandalorian”</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “The Mandalorian ---> Jango Fett”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The PC website card list shows the new title by 14 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1250_8-new">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003542/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-03-14] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130426102042/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-04-26] (Internet Archive): “Jango Fett” (these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 10) prints the card as “•Jango Fett” (lore “Trade Federation.”)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=10, page 10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May ▼ Jet Pack on him for free; he moves using it for -1 Force. Permanent weapon is Dual Blasters (may lose 1 Force to target a Jedi; until end of turn, choose: target may not fire weapons OR target loses immunity to attrition).” The game text did not change. The PC website card list writes the pilot icon and the ▼ out (“May deploy Jet Pack on him for free from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), icon notation only. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-8-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-jangofett-pre.gif]]) print it.
